correctness.rationale: For all odd n≥3, triangle reversals of a regular cyclic tournament, conjugated by vertex relabelling, realize every signed triangle circulation as a difference of regular-tournament binary edge incidence vectors. Fundamental rooted triangle circulations form a Z-basis of ker_Z B; hence every full-support covariance has cut-space kernel im B^T and rank (n−1)(n−2)/2. Principal covariance nullity is c(F)−1 for omitted-edge graph F. Fundamental cycle matrices are totally unimodular in tree-complement coordinates; their maximal nonzero minors coincide with spanning-tree complements. Cauchy–Binet gives n^(n−2) and the common determinant pdet(C)/n^(n−2), including arbitrary positive nonuniform weights. Independent enumeration at n=3,5 confirms regular-tournament counts 2,24, uniform covariance, rank 1,6; a nonuniform 1:24 weight law gave equal two different tree-complement determinants 6503/54675. Pair endpoint transpositions give joint fair matching characters. Central symmetry plus scalar projected covariance implies spherical 3-design; edge fourth moment 1 differs from sphere value 3d/(d+2) for n≥5. Check n=3 d=1 as S^0 exactly.
